negative.name: relay_authenticated_byte_tamper
negative.operation: For every byte offset in relay_authenticated_bytes_hex, xor the byte with 0x01 and require AUTH_INVALID.

negative.name: relay_profile_or_algorithm_downgrade
negative.operation: Change either two-byte identifier in relay_auth_hex and require AUTH_INVALID.

negative.name: hpke_envelope_byte_tamper
negative.operation: For every byte offset in hpke_payload_hex, xor the byte with 0x01 and require rejection without plaintext.

negative.name: hpke_associated_data_tamper
negative.operation: Independently replace queue-id, sender, recipient, and message-id with 32 bytes of 0x09 and require decryption failure.

negative.name: hpke_key_mismatch
negative.operation: Replace the expected sender public key or recipient private key and require decryption failure.
